**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 13 (Access Rights and Licence) satisfies the preferred LICENSE position on all material terms:

- **Affiliates/contractors** — 13.1 grants access rights directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with Authorized Users permitted; 13.2 extends the paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates and allows contractors to support the material. No written-notice gating needed, so this exceeds the fallback.
- **Not revocable at will** — 13.2 is expressly "perpetual, irrevocable"; 13.3 confines revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
- **Successor transfer** — 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor, supported by 24.1 (assignment without Vendor consent in an M&A/asset transfer) and 24.4 (no Vendor termination, repricing, or service reduction on Customer change of control).

The 13.4 restrictions are standard use limitations with carve-outs for legally protected reverse engineering, authorized security testing, and Customer Data — they do not narrow the grant in a way that implicates this rule.
